# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/reviewers

Return all users that can be requested to review in this repo

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-255`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — UserList

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `[]` | User | Array of users who can review |

- **403** — Doer has no permission to get reviewers
- **404** — Repo not found

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Only users who can change review requests can view the reviewers list | authorization | !issue_service.CanDoerChangeReviewRequests(ctx, ctx.Doer, ctx.Repo.Repository, 0) |
| CanDoerChangeReviewRequests allows poster, owner, collaborators, and org team members with PR read access | authorization | doer.ID == posterID || doer.ID == repo.OwnerID || isCollaborator || org team member |
| Reviewers include collaborators with read+ access and org team members with PR read access, excluding poster | business_logic | mode >= perm.AccessModeRead for collaborators; PR unit read access for org teams |
